question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the given situation.**

I was very excited about my new assignment. I sent the email without the required attachment. What have I done?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Jumped the gun."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Jump the gun"** means to do something too soon, before the appropriate time.

 
 
• **Example:** *They only met three weeks ago – isn't it **jumping the gun**__ to start talking about marriage?*
 
 
 
• In the given situation, the speaker was too excited and sent the email without double-checking if the attachment was included.
 
• The idiom **"Jumped the gun"** is commonly used in situations where someone makes a mistake due to impatience or eagerness.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Shook a leg**: This idiom means to dance or move quickly. (नाचना या तेजी से चलना)
 
• **As swift as an eagle**: This phrase describes someone or something that is very fast or efficient. (कोई व्यक्ति या वस्तु जो बहुत तेज़ या कुशल हो)
 
• **Tested the waters**: This idiom means to try something out before committing fully. (पूरी तरह से प्रतिबद्ध होने से पहले किसी चीज़ को आज़माना)
